semanticChecks: Shaving begins with resident appearance/preference, skin/product/device instructions, explained action and consent; staff never unilaterally chooses tidy form. Near-right-angle skin/wrinkle-stretch illustration is example, not strong pressing or universal angle for different blade/head structures.

Check shaved places to notice missed hair/unnecessary repeated passes and skin/resident sensation. Finish moisturizer/lotion remains skin/preference/plan appropriate, never universal product instruction.

Square-off versus deep/diagonal bias cutting, clipper versus file, long/sharp nail injury/dirt and cleanliness/protection purpose retained; deeper is not cleaner, name knowledge never authorizes abnormal nail procedure. Pain/redness/swelling explicitly goes to medical staff; postbath softness/hurry never authorizes independent abnormal-nail treatment.

Text/image learning differs from complete conditions for safe actual product use; individual plan/product instructions/facility training retained, no untrained trials or unconfirmed recorded outcomes.

Bed-wash appropriate warm towel/cleansing product when bathing/shower unsuitable retains circulation/muscle stimulation without stronger-rubbing inference. Whole/partial areas require separate consent/preferences/current condition.

Clean/used supplies separated; face/arms/chest+abdomen/back/legs and genital area separate with consent/clean-contaminated distinction. Avoid spreading contamination, preserve warmth and minimal exposure.

Face eye-area start/behind ears/neck retained. Shoulder horizontal/chest-abdomen-buttock circular/back-side long arrows show region/direction, not identical movements. Limb broad wiping segments use joints as boundaries, not joints-only wiping. Stable pressure never same force for everyone; thin/injured/painful skin and response/range dictate method, no force/count from arrows.

Residual cleanser may itch and must be checked/removed; promptly dry each washed region and cover while attending another. Whole-body wet exposure then final drying does not assure equal warmth/modesty.

Hotter preparation water and adjustment water are contextual examples, not identical container/towel/skin-contact temperatures. Appropriate preparation/use temperature confirmed by plan/method; never apply adjustment-hot water directly or carry over body, no hotter-is-better. Arm-only choice never expanded by available whole-body supplies.

Mobility linked to resident purpose/eating/toileting/washing/social exchange and participation. ADL versus IADL retains all food/dressing/bathing/elimination/movement and shopping/money/laundry/transport/communication examples; one ADL never proves all IADL.

Budget/shopping choices retained despite wheelchair mobility help; no automatic family control or removal of movement assistance because money management intact. Individual habits/values/decision/doing portions govern needed support.

Standing/sitting/lying, chair/edge/long sitting and support/foot positions distinguished; supine/side/prone with exact Japanese headword/kana learning refs. Right side is resident right down, not facing worker right; body-contact side beyond face direction checked.

Position/current state versus change action and named examples preserved. Supine broad support not universally optimal; pain/breathing/skin/preference matter. Fowler/semi-Fowler names never fixed common angle. Side cushions chest/lower leg/between legs and half-sit foot-end lift or knee cushion if unadjustable retain individual/device/location/thickness/skin checks.
Pillow placed does not confirm comfort. Supported site/position/pain/breathing/resident words and measured-after-adjustment result separately recorded.

Disuse possible muscle wasting/joint restriction/bone/sensory/mental/cardiopulmonary/BP/internal/nutrition/activity changes retained; lying duration not total ability. Orthostatic BP fall/dizziness/palpitations/dyspnea are reported observations, new signs not independently blamed on inactivity.

Pressure injury sustained pressure/blood-flow mechanism and occiput/scapula/elbow/sacrum-buttock/heel contact checks retained; one site/posture cannot clear whole-body risk. Wrinkles/friction/shear plus movement/support/skin/activity/nutrition all considered; flat sheet never resolves sustained heel pressure.

Individualized activity/out-of-bed/reposition/pressure relief/nutrition combinations, post-action response and no universal schedule retained. Redness explicitly reported to medical staff before wound, not delayed. Back-shear release concept after raising torso never permits independent pulling/lifting; appropriate tools/help/trained facility method required.

T cane light/easy versus multipoint broader support and lower-limb stability/strength example not automatic fit; walker support width never universal ranking. Actual movements/location/equipment/professional assessment retained.
Ceiling/floor mobile lifts support transfer and can reduce resident/worker burden when appropriately used; product/condition/training mandatory, fully-assisted people not routinely manually lifted.

Wheel versus handrim and resident self-propulsion versus helper handle use distinguished; handles never prove inability. Back/seat/arm/leg/foot supports and casters retain roles, foot support never standing step.

Parking versus attendant brakes differ. Empty stopped chair still parking brake; tires/effect checked before use, low air may impair brake and lever position alone not inspection. Tipping lever wheel raise/lower only design-fit trained method, not untried curb maneuver; defective/unclear equipment not continued.

Movement versus transfer/rising/rolling/lying-in-bed/leaving-bed exact Japanese/kana terms and full Burmese meanings retained. Sliding sheet friction versus lift/walker, silver-car specific model/ability/use not assumed walker/passenger wheelchair substitute, white cane visual purpose not support-leg-count equivalence.
Brake-apply/cane-ground/grasp-hold/support/speaking-guidance verbs retain contextual action distinctions; reading terms never substitutes explanation/consent/equipment inspection/operation training.
Before reposition: condition/pain/range/explanation/consent/equipment/staff/space/bed height; if unwell no schedule priority, explicitly tell medical staff or appropriate recipient.

Left hemiparesis example rolls paretic side up, possible knee flexion/compactness facilitates turning with resident remaining ability; never pull paretic arm to move whole body. After turn pelvis/waist backward and comfortable legs broaden stable support, distinct time/purpose from compact preparation, not simultaneous contradiction.

Rising example exact right side→legs edge/down→right elbow support→torso rise→edge sit retained; coordination example not universal right-arm instruction. Personal strength/range/plan/practical training govern.

Worker height protects own low back; edge sitting requires both soles appropriately floor-supported, stage change means worker height not automatically resident height. After change check pain/feeling/dizziness/feet/balance; rise completed not stable sitting or permission for next stand/transfer. Unknown method/change means seek help before next act.
Hip-range-limited person never inherits left-hemiparesis illustrated action solely by label/orientation; individual assessment/possible movement/plan/trained method precede action.
